label: Synthetic contract performance demonstration
population_rule: Recorded member-months for this payer with a received practice attribution in the performance period; no visit-plurality or current-coverage substitution.
amount_basis: Final payer allowed cents on non-superseded metric claims, matched to the same patient's attributed payer/member month; observed through the current source snapshot, without completion estimation. Not provider revenue or cash.
assumptions: All terms, benchmark, sharing rate, quality target and scope in this file are authored demonstration assumptions, not a received payer offer or executed contract.
The registered CBP approximation is deliberately reused as a synthetic demo quality rule for 2029; its published reference year is not a verified 2029 contract specification.

One-sided illustrative sharing applies only to positive observed benchmark variance when the approximate quality target is met. No minimum savings threshold, cap, risk adjustment or completion factor is assumed.
Recorded member-month coverage is not event-date eligibility. Missing source capture, unreceived claims and clinical appropriateness remain unestablished.
